resources.string: "Before saving an academic account, read the Privacy Policy to understand how credentials are used, where they are sent, and how they are stored locally."

"Try mobile data when a Wi-Fi request fails; data charges may apply. Only safely retryable read-only requests fall back once. Login passwords are never resent, and QMplus web traffic remains managed by the system."
"Unable to save the mobile-data setting. Please retry. If disabling fails, mobile-data fallback still stops for this session."
"Assignments not fetched yet. Refresh them explicitly in the assignments view."
"No assignments or quizzes for this course in the current snapshot."
"No cached assignments linked to this course."
"Could not enable reminders. Check notification permission and try again."
"Could not open precise reminder settings. Approximate delivery remains available."

"Uses your local timetable for future classes and timed exams in Beijing time, 10 minutes before by default. Precise reminder access is granted; powering off or system restrictions may still affect delivery. Daily summaries are separate. Settings stay on this device and are not uploaded."

"Uses your local timetable for future classes and timed exams in Beijing time, 10 minutes before by default. Delivery is approximate: battery saving may delay or miss reminders. Expired reminders are not replayed. Daily summaries are separate. Settings stay on this device and are not uploaded."
"Set 1–5 different reminder times, each 1–1440 minutes before class. Retry if saving fails."
"Your account and password stay on this device and are protected by Android Keystore."
"Refresh current courses using the existing Teaching Cloud Platform session, without fetching every assignment."
"Shows today’s course summary at the selected Beijing time"
"Only notifies on days with courses, around the chosen Beijing time. Battery saving may delay delivery. Time changes reschedule immediately; at most one summary per day."
"Could not save or reschedule the reminder. Please try again."
"Unable to save your consent, so the app cannot continue."

"Welcome to Where To Study. Please read and understand the Privacy Policy before continuing. When you save an account or request schedules, classrooms, or assignments, the app sends necessary information over HTTPS to relevant BUPT services. After valid credentials are saved, enabled settings may also refresh the schedule and today’s empty classrooms automatically. Schedules, credentials, and preferences stay on this device. By tapping “Agree and Continue,” you confirm that you have read and agree to the Privacy Policy. If you decline, the app exits and its main features remain unavailable."
"Unable to open the full Privacy Policy. Please try again later."
"Unable to clear the QMplus course cache. Please retry."
"QMplus course snapshot saved; refresh through the official page."

"A valid app-owned session can sync directly. Sign-in details are not saved by default; only an explicit choice and save enables separate local encryption and one autofill attempt on a trusted official page. You still complete CAPTCHA, MFA and other verification. External browser cookies are never read. The business snapshot contains no passwords, cookies or sesskey; disconnecting clears the app-owned session, snapshot and saved sign-in details."
"Detail restricted or incomplete; unconfirmed times are not inferred."
"Local business data cleared. The QMplus web session is clearing asynchronously; reconnect is disabled until it completes."
"QMplus not connected. Complete official SSO / MFA in Settings, then sync courses."
"This sync is incomplete; previously known activities are retained. Missing activities are not assumed completed or deleted."
"Quiz (availability is not a fixed exam time)"
"Syncing courses and published assignments / quizzes read-only…"
"Term unconfirmed; not automatically treated as current"
"QMplus sync did not complete. Check the official login and network, then retry. The previous course cache is unaffected."

"Complete any required verification on the official page, then courses sync automatically. You can also select “Sync Courses”. Only courses and published assignments / quizzes are read; nothing is submitted and no quiz attempt is started."
"This device cannot open the official QMplus login page. Check that System WebView is available, then retry. The previous course cache is unaffected."
"Today’s Courses widget preview, %1$s, with %2$d sample courses"
"Today’s courses appear first; spare space shows courses marked “Tomorrow”, within the course limit. This preview uses fictional data and does not change your schedule."
"View today’s courses, periods, rooms, instructors, and status on your home screen."
